title: Sharp exponential integrability of conjugate functions
summary: We prove that if a real-valued function $f\in L^1$ on the complex unit circle has a gap of width at least $π$ in its essential range, then $\exp(\tilde f)$ is not integrable, where $\tilde f$ is the conjugate function.
